author: sileixu
description:
Mahjong Winning Tiles (胡啥牌) Benchmark
	


	
		
		Introduction
	

Mahjong Winning Tiles is a benchmark dataset designed to evaluate the reasoning capability of large language models (LLMs). It focuses on assessing logical thinking, pattern recognition, and decision-making by challenging models to calculate possible winning tiles needed to complete a Mahjong hand of 13 tiles. 

	
		
		Background: Mahjong Rules
	

Mahjong is a traditional 4-player tile game originating from China and… See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/sileixu/mahjong-winning-tiles.

author: mitsutani
description:
MahjongLM Dataset
	

MahjongLM Dataset is a processed, pre-tokenized riichi mahjong game-log corpus for causal language modeling.
It is built from Tenhou game logs and is intended for training MahjongLM-family models to predict long structured mahjong token streams.
The dataset is distributed as token IDs, not as raw Tenhou XML. The corresponding tokenizer assets are included in this repository.

description:

public simulation round, collected for opponent modeling and on-distribution evaluation.
